evidence: AllTick's current official Free plan is $0 and includes only 10 demo instruments, including Tesla for US stocks, at 10 API calls/minute and one WebSocket connection.

AllTick's Basic paid plan ($99/month) adds Order book and Real-time tick; full US-stock coverage is a much higher paid plan.
AllTick's REST launch announcement exposes Latest quotes and Latest order book endpoints, but product availability is plan-entitled and the Free plan does not grant order book/realtime tick.

reopen_condition: Only reopen if AllTick Free permanently includes consolidated US National NBBO bid/ask plus last trade with independent event timestamps and explicit automated/non-display entitlement, without subscription/funding/balance/activity/per-query monetary condition.
